title: FV Mind R17: Invisible Gorilla and exact Zen12 claim disposition
source_quality_rule: Seller material proves merchant positioning and described format only; independent product outcome claims require product-specific substantiation.

claims.claim: The 1999 experiment involved counting passes with an unexpected gorilla-like event.
claims.editorial_handling: In a set of controlled moving-scene monitoring tasks, not every real-world task.

claims.claim: Overall unnoticed rates are a universal 46% for everyone.
claims.editorial_handling: Rates vary by conditions; no fixed human prevalence.

claims.claim: Similarity of unexpected event to attended team and task difficulty affected noticing.
claims.editorial_handling: Report condition-dependence; no general deterministic prediction.

claims.claim: The 1999 paper was published in September 1999.
claims.editorial_handling: Publisher bibliographic record.

claims.claim: The original paper can diagnose an individual attentional deficit.
claims.editorial_handling: Experimental paradigm, not clinical diagnostic tool.

claims.claim: The 2010 follow-up included a changing curtain and a departing player.
claims.editorial_handling: Known-gorilla experiment.

claims.claim: Prior gorilla familiarity enhanced noticing of other changes.
claims.editorial_handling: Not established; familiarity did not improve other-event detection.

claims.claim: 2010 lower noticing in familiar group proves familiarity harms perception.
claims.editorial_handling: Difference not statistically significant; cannot imply causal decrement.

claims.claim: The 2013 study tested 24 radiologists with inserted gorilla in a CT case.
claims.editorial_handling: Constrained expert visual search test.

claims.claim: Eighty-three percent of the radiologists did not report seeing the gorilla.
claims.editorial_handling: Sample specific n=24; not diagnostic error rate.

claims.claim: The gorilla was 48 times the size of an average nodule.
claims.editorial_handling: Authors describe size relative to task target.

claims.claim: Eye tracking showed most who missed looked at gorilla location.
claims.editorial_handling: Location fixations do not imply perceptual recognition.

claims.claim: 83% of clinical radiologists routinely overlook medical abnormalities.
claims.editorial_handling: A nonmedical inserted image does not quantify routine diagnostic errors.

claims.claim: Selective-looking work predates 1999.
claims.editorial_handling: Neisser and Becklen studied attention in 1975.

claims.claim: The publisher has tested Puységur cases with the gorilla experiment.
claims.editorial_handling: Only a methodological analogy; historical sources are different.

claims.claim: Final Vestige has a published Puységur archive and Focus landing page.
claims.editorial_handling: Read-only WordPress verification 2026-10-31.

claims.claim: The live site contains 61 published investigation posts.
claims.editorial_handling: WordPress authenticated list returned 61 published post objects; website categories not altered.

claims.claim: Inspire3 catalog carries Zen12.
claims.editorial_handling: Seller official catalog identity.

claims.claim: Zen12 advertises twelve progressive levels.
claims.editorial_handling: Feature as described by merchant, bundle not independently inspected.

claims.claim: Zen12 advertises twelve-minute sessions.
claims.editorial_handling: Seller-described duration only.

claims.claim: Zen12 offers four formats per level.
claims.editorial_handling: Music, guided, noise, nature, seller-described.

claims.claim: Zen12 checkout describes 48 MP3 files in the bundle.
claims.editorial_handling: Seller-described format, not personally inspected.

claims.claim: Zen12 automatically changes the brainwaves of all listeners.
claims.editorial_handling: Seller psychological mechanism; no SKU-specific independent confirmation.

claims.claim: Twelve minutes of Zen12 equals one hour of meditation benefits.
claims.editorial_handling: Do not state as established; no direct independent equivalence trial.

claims.claim: Zen12 always erases anxiety and stress.
claims.editorial_handling: Unsubstantiated clinical/generalized guarantee.

claims.claim: Zen12 will help viewers notice invisible gorillas.
claims.editorial_handling: None of experiments evaluated Zen12.

claims.claim: Meditation is always harmless.
claims.editorial_handling: NCCIH reports incomplete harm data and potential negative experiences.

claims.claim: A 2023 auditory entrainment review directly validates Zen12.
claims.editorial_handling: Research concerns binaural beats/EEG studies, not the Zen12 recordings.

claims.claim: Binaural beat review results were inconsistent.
claims.editorial_handling: The review counted 5 positive, 8 negative, 1 mixed among 14 studies.

claims.claim: A 2019 binaural beats meta-analysis measured Zen12 outcomes.
claims.editorial_handling: Category review cannot be promoted as product-specific trial.

claims.claim: An affiliate disclosure should be conspicuous and near an earning link.
claims.editorial_handling: Precede and visually associate with the recommendation.

claims.claim: General sitewide disclosures suffice alone even when distant from the link.
claims.editorial_handling: FTC recommends near-link clear relationship.

claims.claim: Health and cognitive benefit claims need adequate product-specific proof.
claims.editorial_handling: If absent suppress product efficacy claims.

claims.claim: Final Vestige is verified as an active authorized Zen12 affiliate.
claims.editorial_handling: No account-level written acceptance/URL/terms.

claims.claim: Specific affiliate commissions or payout percentage are verified.
claims.editorial_handling: No evidence; do not publish.

claims.claim: A current Zen12 price, discount or countdown can be frozen into evergreen copy.
claims.editorial_handling: Dynamic checkout. No price/urgency published in guide.

claims.claim: The official seller offers currently approved creatives usable by FV.
claims.editorial_handling: Approval and asset-use rights not accessible.

claims.claim: A text guide with optional 40-second film will convert better than text alone.
claims.editorial_handling: Experiment hypothesis; no conversions observed or guaranteed.

claims.claim: Film playback alone proves any merchant purchase or conversion.
claims.editorial_handling: Only partner validated downstream data could establish completed sale.

claims.claim: A 12-minute timer is a free alternative to a paid audio recording.
claims.editorial_handling: Descriptive option, not outcome claim.

claims.claim: Marketing an unpublished /mind/ draft as a live page is acceptable.
claims.editorial_handling: Must publish only after founder and QA approval.

claims.claim: The existing single Jetpack Focus subscription must remain unchanged.
claims.editorial_handling: No duplicate forms or welcome rewrite.

claims.claim: The proposed static diagram accurately quantifies inattentional blindness.
claims.editorial_handling: It is a reflection graphic only, not a research implementation.

claims.claim: Video alternative B must have a poster, captions or transcript and user controls.
claims.editorial_handling: Accessibility requirement; production verification not complete.

claims.claim: The merchant seller description is sufficient evidence of personal experience.
claims.editorial_handling: No editor tested or purchased Zen12.
